attributes.action: No military conscription until UK secures borders and ends illegal immigration
attributes.additional_details: We demand that the UK Government rule out compulsory military conscription for British men until it has secured our borders, stopped all illegal immigration and deported those who entered unlawfully, subject to legal obligations. Successive governments have eroded national pride and confidence in Britain. We believe British men should not be forced to fight for a country whose government has failed to protect it. Restore our pride and give us a country worth fighting for.
attributes.background: We demand no military conscription for British men until the Government stops all illegal immigration, secures our borders and deports illegal entrants. Successive governments have eroded our national pride. We want a Britain worth fighting for before being forced to fight for it.

rejection.details:
There has been a clear Government statement that there are no plans for conscription - and we cannot accept hypothetical or contingent petitions which suggest there are such plans  

https://questions-statements.parliament.uk/written-questions/detail/2026-09-01/hl2915
